description: This file contains a unit test class 'LicenseTest' for testing the 'License' entity within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It sets up test data, persists an entity, and verifies the entity's properties through assertions.

classes.name: LicenseTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the 'License' entity, including setup, entity creation, persistence, and assertions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating the License table before each test.

methods.name: testLicenseEntity
methods.description: Creates a new License entity, sets its name, persists it, retrieves it from the repository, and asserts its properties.
